email.subject: Studio 9 Co's site on mobile
email.body:
Hi Hannah,

I checked Studio 9 Co's website and noticed it isn't set up for mobile phones — the layout breaks on a phone screen, which is likely where most people search for a salon near them in Harbor Falls. On top of that, the page title just says something generic rather than "Studio 9 Co Hair Studio - Harbor Falls," so you're probably getting skipped in search results too.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
